skill.name: executing-plans
skill.description: Guide Claude through a complete implementation plan by reviewing it first, executing tasks in small batches, verifying each batch, and pausing for feedback.
skill.summary: Execute implementation plans in controlled batches with review checkpoints.
skill.author: DYAI2025

security_audit.summary: The readable skill file is prompt-only and describes a controlled implementation workflow with checkpoints and verification. The only confirmed issue is the included SKILL.zip artifact, which was not statically scanned and should receive manual review before publication.

remediation.issue: Unscanned binary archive included in the skill package.
remediation.suggestion: Remove SKILL.zip from the published package or provide a scanner-readable source-only distribution.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.zip is an included binary archive that static analysis could not inspect. This is a real publication risk because hidden content could differ from the reviewed SKILL.md, even though no malicious behavior was found in the readable file.

low_findings.title: Unscanned file (binary) — manual review required
low_findings.confidence_reasoning: SKILL.zip is an included binary archive that static analysis could not inspect. This is a real publication risk because hidden content could differ from the reviewed SKILL.md, even though no malicious behavior was found in the readable file.

content.value_statement: Large implementation plans can fail when agents skip review or push through blockers. This skill keeps work controlled through critical plan review, small execution batches, verification, and feedback checkpoints.
actual_capabilities: Loads and reviews a complete implementation plan before work begins.
Identifies concerns or missing details before executing tasks.
Executes the first three tasks by default as a controlled batch.
Marks task progress and runs verifications specified by the plan.
Reports completed work and verification output between batches.
Stops and asks for help when blockers or repeated verification failures occur.
limitations: Requires a complete implementation plan from the user or partner.
Does not create the plan from scratch.
Depends on the plan to define clear tasks and verification steps.
Pauses between batches, so it is not designed for unattended execution.

use_cases.title: Implement a reviewed feature plan
use_cases.description: Execute a feature plan in small batches while preserving architect review points.

use_cases.title: Control risky refactor execution
use_cases.description: Follow a refactor checklist carefully, verify each batch, and stop when blockers appear.

use_cases.title: Coordinate agent work with human feedback
use_cases.description: Keep an AI coding agent aligned with a human partner through explicit progress reports.

prompt_templates.title: Run a simple plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner use with an existing plan file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill with this implementation plan. Review it first, then execute the first batch and report verification results.

prompt_templates.title: Pause after each batch
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate use when human review is required.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill for this plan. After each batch, stop and wait for my feedback before continuing.

prompt_templates.title: Check for plan gaps before coding
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate use for plans that may be incomplete.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill. Critically review the plan for missing steps, unclear instructions, and verification gaps before starting implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Execute a complex migration plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced use for multi-stage engineering work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill to execute this migration plan in batches of three tasks. Stop immediately on blockers, failed verification, or unclear instructions.

output_examples.input: Use this plan to implement the authentication cleanup.
output_examples.output: I reviewed the plan and found no blockers. I completed tasks 1 through 3, ran the specified checks, and am ready for feedback.

output_examples.input: Continue with the next batch of the refactor plan.
output_examples.output: I completed the next three tasks and verified the changed behavior. One test failed repeatedly, so I stopped and need clarification before continuing.
I found two unclear steps and one missing verification requirement. I recommend resolving those points before starting the first batch.

best_practices: Provide a complete plan with small tasks and clear verification steps.
Review the first checkpoint carefully before approving more batches.
Treat repeated verification failures as blockers, not as optional warnings.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill when no implementation plan exists.
Do not ask the agent to skip checkpoints for speed.
Do not continue after unclear instructions or failed verification.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps an AI coding agent execute a complete implementation plan in controlled batches with review checkpoints.

faq.question: Does it write an implementation plan?
faq.answer: No. It is designed to execute a plan that already exists.

faq.question: How many tasks does it run at once?
faq.answer: The default batch size is the first three tasks, unless the user gives a different instruction.

faq.question: When should the agent stop?
faq.answer: It should stop when it finds a blocker, unclear instruction, missing dependency, or repeated verification failure.

faq.question: Is this useful for large refactors?
faq.answer: Yes. It is useful when the refactor has a clear plan and needs staged review.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
